trend_oracle_bounds.description: random walk with a cycle (c=0, lam=1)
slowly reverting AR, half-life~113.5 weeks (c=5.0), with a cycle
random walk with constant volatility (c=0, r=0, lam=0)

assumptions.reversion_null_family: restricted to AR, c=0 (random-walk) members of the declared grid across all cycle/volatility-shape variations (76 of 1216 members), not the full 1216-member family, as a tractable, unambiguously non-reverting null subgrid.
assumptions.n_draws_reduced: n_draws reduced below config.ORACLE_N_SIMULATIONS_RUN for the non-full run: oracle_power_bound's cost against a 1216-member null grid is dominated by per-null covariance construction, not n_draws; use --full for config.ORACLE_N_SIMULATIONS_PAPER draws.
